take.title_zh: 設計工具 AI 化的臨界點：Config 2026 之後
take.title_en: After Config 2026: Design Tools Cross the AI Threshold
take.body_zh:
本週最大事件是 Figma Config 2026（6/23–25，舊金山），一口氣發布 Motion 動畫、Code Layers、Shader 生成與擴展版 AI Agent。Figma CEO Dylan Field 開場即拋出挑釁：「AI 降低了地板，但沒有拉高天花板——設計師才是那個舉高天花板的人。」這句話既安撫了對 AI 取代設計師的焦慮，也清晰劃出 Figma 的產品定位：用 AI 工具賦能人類創意，而非複製人類創意。

Motion 的到來尤其值得關注：從靜態原型到可輸出 production-ready 動畫，Figma 正式跨入動態設計領域，讓設計師和工程師在同一個畫布上協作動效。Code Layers 將 Git repo 直接引入設計工作流，意味著「設計與開發的邊界」正在被系統性地模糊。AI 成為設計材料、而非設計助理，是 Config 2026 最清晰的訊號。
take.body_en:
The week's defining event was Figma Config 2026 (June 23–25, San Francisco), which landed Motion, Code Layers, Shader generation, and an expanded AI Agent simultaneously. CEO Dylan Field's opening line set the tone: "AI has lowered the floor but not the ceiling — designers are the ones who raise the ceiling." The framing simultaneously defuses AI-replacement anxiety and clarifies Figma's product bet: amplify human creativity rather than replicate it.

Motion deserves special attention — Figma now spans static prototypes to production-ready animations on a single canvas, while Code Layers pipe Git repositories directly into design workflows. The boundary between design and engineering is being methodically dissolved. The clearest signal from Config 2026: AI is becoming a design material, not just a design assistant.

articles.title_zh: Figma 一口氣發布 Code Layers、Motion 動畫與更多 AI 功能
articles.title_en: Figma Adds Code Layers, Animations, and More AI Features at Config 2026
articles.summary_zh: Figma 於 Config 2026（6/23–25）發布多項重大更新：Motion 讓設計師可在 Figma 內直接製作 production-ready 動畫，支援 keyframe 與預設動效；Code Layers 將 Git repo 引入協作畫布，方便從程式碼提取設計流程；Shader 生成工具以 open beta 形式向付費用戶開放，可在畫布上即時生成視覺材質；AI Agent 從聊天側欄升級為「團隊知識系統」，設計師可將決策與創意方向封裝為可重用的 slash command，分享給整個團隊。
articles.summary_en: At Config 2026, Figma shipped Motion (production-ready animations with keyframes and presets), Code Layers (Git repos surfaced inside the design canvas), open-beta Shader generation for paid users, and an upgraded AI Agent that now functions as a team knowledge system — letting designers package their creative direction into reusable slash commands for the whole team.
articles.take_zh: Motion 的推出讓 Figma 從靜態原型正式進入動態設計，Code Layers 模糊了設計與工程邊界；這不是功能更新，是設計師工作流程的結構性重組。
articles.take_en: Motion and Code Layers aren't incremental features — they structurally redefine where design ends and engineering begins, signaling Figma's push to own the full product-building canvas.

articles.title_zh: Stratechery 專訪 Figma CEO Dylan Field：設計師如何在 AI 時代舉高天花板 [Paywall]
articles.title_en: An Interview with Figma CEO Dylan Field About Design and AI [Paywall]
articles.summary_zh: Ben Thompson 在 Config 2026 期間對話 Figma CEO Dylan Field，深入討論 AI 對設計專業的衝擊與機遇。Field 提出「AI 降低地板、設計師舉高天花板」的框架，認為 AI 大幅降低了製作物件的技術門檻，但這也意味著人類創意的差異化價值更高、而非更低。訪談也涵蓋 Figma 的 IPO 計畫現況、AI Agent 的產品定位，以及設計工具在 AI 代理工作流中的角色演變。
articles.summary_en: Ben Thompson interviews Dylan Field at Config 2026, probing AI's impact on design work. Field's core thesis: AI lowers the technical floor for making things, which paradoxically raises the value of human creative distinction. The conversation also covers Figma's IPO timeline, AI Agent positioning, and how design tools fit into agentic product workflows.
articles.take_zh: 「降低地板」框架是 Config 2026 最有份量的戰略宣言——把 AI 工具化焦慮轉化為設計師的機遇論述，也為 Figma 的下一步產品路線提供了清晰的哲學依據。
articles.take_en: "Lowering the floor" is Config's most consequential strategic statement — it reframes AI anxiety as a designer opportunity and gives Figma's product roadmap a coherent philosophical anchor.

articles.title_zh: Figma Config 2026 完整回顧：Motion、Code、Shader 與 AI 全解析
articles.title_en: Figma Config 2026: Motion, Code, Shaders & AI — Full Recap
articles.summary_zh: Config 2026 是 Figma 歷年最大型產品發布會，主題「新材料、新工具、更有表現力的畫布」貫穿整場。完整回顧涵蓋 Motion 動畫系統（關鍵影格 + 預設動效）、Code Layers（Git repo 融入設計工作流）、Shader 生成（open beta，付費用戶可用）、AI Agent 升級（從聊天轉為團隊知識系統）。大會也強調 Figma 將設計定位為「更接近工程的創意工作」，設計師與工程師的協作邊界正在被系統性重新定義。
articles.summary_en: A full recap of Config 2026, themed "New materials, new tools, a more expressive canvas." Covers Motion (keyframe animation + presets), Code Layers (Git integration into the design canvas), Shader generation (open beta, paid plans), and the AI Agent upgrade from chat sidebar to team knowledge system. The overarching story: Figma is repositioning design as engineering-adjacent creative work.
articles.take_zh: Config 2026 不是功能更新大會，而是 Figma 對「設計工具邊界」的集體宣告——未來的設計工具應同時是動畫工具、工程協作平台與 AI 材料庫。
articles.take_en: Config 2026 reads as a boundary declaration: Figma is asserting that the next-generation design tool is simultaneously an animation system, an engineering bridge, and an AI material library.

articles.title_zh: Figma 官方整理：Config 2026 所有新功能與適用方案
articles.title_en: What's New from Config 2026 — Official Feature Summary
articles.summary_zh: Figma 官方 Help Center 整理了 Config 2026 全部新功能的說明文件，涵蓋 Motion、Code Layers、Shader 生成、AI Agent 擴充，以及各功能的適用對象（Full seat vs. Professional 方案）、推出時程與使用方式。特別標注 Shader 生成僅限 Full seat 付費方案，AI Agent 新功能的 open beta 資格，以及各功能在 iOS / Android 的支援狀況，是設計師評估是否升級方案的最直接參考。
articles.summary_en: Figma's official documentation for all Config 2026 features — Motion, Code Layers, Shader generation, and AI Agent upgrades — including plan eligibility (Full seat vs. Professional), rollout timelines, and iOS/Android platform support. The practical reference for teams deciding whether to upgrade plans to access headline features.
articles.take_zh: 方案門檻直接影響誰能用到 Config 新功能：Shader 生成等 Full seat 限定功能意味著許多中小型設計團隊需要重新評估訂閱計畫。
articles.take_en: Plan gating matters: Shader generation is Full-seat-only, meaning many smaller teams won't access the headline Config features without upgrading — worth auditing before assuming full access.

articles.title_zh: Figma AI 2026 完整能力盤點：能做什麼、還不能做什麼
articles.title_en: Figma AI in 2026: Everything It Can Do — and What It Still Can't
articles.summary_zh: LogRocket 系統盤點了 Figma 在 2026 年的全部 AI 功能，包括 Auto Layout 智慧建議、組件自動命名、原型生成、文案潤飾與翻譯、圖片填充等。評測也坦誠指出目前極限：複雜互動邏輯無法自動生成、對設計系統的理解仍相對淺層、多品牌切換支援不足。整體結論：Figma AI 適合加速重複性設計任務，但「真正的設計思考」仍需要人來主導。
articles.summary_en: LogRocket audits every Figma AI feature in 2026 — Auto Layout suggestions, auto-naming, prototype generation, copy refinement, and image fills — while honestly marking the limits: complex interaction logic, shallow design-system comprehension, and weak multi-brand support. Verdict: Figma AI accelerates repetitive work; strategic design thinking remains human territory.
articles.take_zh: 系統性能力盤點對設計師和 PM 都是決策工具：知道 AI 做不到什麼，才能把省出的時間投入更高層次的創意與策略判斷。
articles.take_en: Knowing exactly what Figma AI can't do is as valuable as knowing what it can — it tells teams where to reinvest time saved on repetitive tasks into higher-order creative and strategic work.

articles.title_zh: 2026 年 Figma 如何支援 AI 驅動的多通路產品設計
articles.title_en: Figma in 2026: How Multi-Channel Product Design Will Evolve With AI
articles.summary_zh: 本文探討 AI 如何讓 Figma 從「單一平台設計工具」演化為多通路產品設計的核心平台。作者分析 Figma 在 Web、Mobile、Watch、AR/VR 多通路設計的適用性，以及 AI 在自動適配 layout、生成多尺寸版本上的潛力。文章指出 Config 2026 的 Motion 和 Code Layers 是 Figma 跨通路擴張的重要基礎，設計師需要開始規劃「設計系統 × AI 自動化」的整合策略。
articles.summary_en: An analysis of how AI transforms Figma from a single-platform tool into the hub for multi-channel product design across Web, Mobile, Watch, and AR/VR — with AI handling layout adaptation and multi-size generation. Config 2026's Motion and Code Layers are flagged as the foundation for Figma's cross-channel expansion, urging designers to plan design-system × AI-automation integration strategies now.
articles.take_zh: 多通路設計的複雜度正是 AI 最能發揮的地方——讓機器處理尺寸適配，讓設計師聚焦品牌一致性與體驗決策。
articles.take_en: Multi-channel complexity is where AI earns its keep — automating layout adaptation so designers stay focused on brand coherence and experience strategy rather than resizing assets.
